title: polypodium viscidum
intro: Polypodium viscidum, commonly known as American polypody, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium viscidum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable remedy for soothing and protecting the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
